summary: Wrote a 5-phase, 4.5-hour plan extending plan-file-scope-harvest.sh (source store) with one capability-gated post-processing stage: it fires only when the harvested array already holds a .lean path and the repo carries check-module-invariants.sh and typst-sync-check.sh, then appends typst/generated/status.typ, every generated-inventory README on the edited paths' directory-ancestor chains (fence-aware, mirroring the generator's own BEGIN_RE and markdown_targets exclusions), and two narrow-glob surfaces. No caller changes: all seven consumers subprocess this one script. Phases 1-4 are local-tier (covered by run-all.sh --only on the three suites suite_selection_select resolves for this path); Phase 5 is full-tier and carries the deploy, the documentation sync, and the dispatch's scope-item-4 replay against both precedent plans. Declared scope is three source-store files and intersects nothing in the concurrent sibling's declared territory.

artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan for capability-gated generated-surface appending in plan-file-scope-harvest.sh, with 11 new regression cases and precedent-plan replay verification.
